ARC: Epilogue ()

=== EPISODE 30: Emperor (643)
Far to the west, a man who owns half the world hears a new name. He turns it over on his tongue, like a grape he hasn’t decided to eat.
[diagram tang-departments]
taizong: Gai Suwen…?
The seventh invasion of Goguryeo has not begun. It has only found its excuse. Now it needs four dragons…!
